messages:
Maya (CS): FYI @Arjun @Jordan — ACME opened a critical escalation: their invoice assistant started returning incorrect totals after yesterday's rollout. Ticket CS-8921.

Elena (ACME): hi team — we saw correct totals until ~2026-02-15 22:10 UTC, after that the assistant adds extra fees that don't exist. Example included below. This is blocking our billing exports. :grimacing:

Maya (CS): Pasted the short repro Elena sent:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd-chat-70b-q4f",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are an invoice assistant."},
    {"role":"user","content":"I have an order: item A $120, item B $80. Any taxes or fees? show total."}
  ]
}
```

And the model reply they got: 
```
Total: $220
Processing Fee: $25
Grand Total: $245
```

Elena (ACME): the Processing Fee never appeared before the rollout. We didn't change prompts.

Arjun (ML): looking — thanks for tagging. Quick context: we rolled out quantization/attention kernel changes to rwd-chat-70b-q4f at 2026-02-15T22:00Z (release tag: quant-attn-2026-02-15). Internal eval suite 'billing-evals-2026-02' passed with no regression.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): we also shipped a small change to KV cache invalidation (PR #4389) earlier that day to reduce stale-cache cases. That change touched the cache flush boundary logic for sequence lengths > 1024.

Maya (CS): Summary: customer prompt -> wrong additional line. Internal evals OK. Possible rollout correlation.

Arjun (ML): can you paste the exact failing completion Elena received (we have a snippet) and the request id if available? Also need model + variant (looks like the q4f variant) and whether they used streaming.

Elena (ACME): request-id: req_0a7f2b9c, non-streaming. Full reply attached in support ticket (copied above).

Jordan (Eng Runtime): grabbing logs for req_0a7f2b9c... 
```
[2026-02-15T22:12:03Z] req_0a7f2b9c model=rwd-chat-70b-q4f seq_len=48 kv_cache_hit=false kernel=attn_opt_v2
[2026-02-15T22:12:03Z] decode_segment_1 tokens=0..31
[2026-02-15T22:12:03Z] decode_segment_2 tokens=32..47
[2026-02-15T22:12:03Z] commit_output: 220, Processing Fee: 25, Grand Total: 245
```

Jordan (Eng Runtime): interesting — decode split across segments. Our cache boundary math may be concatenating a stale partial state that adds an extra ‘fee’ token sequence in the second segment.

Arjun (ML): hypothesis: the kernel change slightly altered attention alignment for split-decode cases which wasn't covered by our billing evals (they're shorter sequences). The extra line looks like a repeated template fragment. Could be a prompt-template fragmentation bug or KV mis-merge.

Maya (CS): action items propose: 1) Reproduce locally with same model variant + request id if possible, 2) Ask ACME for any added system messages or hidden metadata, 3) Add this exact prompt to an expanded eval set.

Arjun (ML): I'll try reproducer — can someone dump the raw tokenisation for the user content for that request id? Need token boundaries to see how the segments align.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): running local repro now using the same model slice and quant kernels. Command I'm using:
```
# reproduce
python -m rwd_repro.driver \
  --model rwd-chat-70b-q4f \
  --input-file acme_prompt.json \
  --force-seg-split 32 \
  --kv-cache-mode reproduce
```

Jordan (Eng Runtime): preliminary: i can reproduce a spurious extra sentence when I force a seg-split at token boundary 32. If I disable the new kv-invalidation code it's gone.

Arjun (ML): that matches the attention-alignment KV hypothesis. Two-pronged fix: short-term rollback of PR #4389 for the variant served to ACME; medium-term add tests that create artificial segment splits and assert deterministic continuation.

Maya (CS): Elena — are you OK with us temporarily swapping ACME to rwd-chat-70b-q4f@pre-quant-attn (previous variant) while we root cause? This would be a config change on your tenant and should be quick.

Elena (ACME): yes please do. We need a fix ASAP — rolling back is fine. Also please keep me posted on timeline.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): starting tenant-level rollback now for tenant acme-corp -> switching to rwd-chat-70b-q4f@2026-01-30 (non-PR4389). I'll post when complete.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1042 (label: model-output-regression). Pager duty: @eng-oncall.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): rollback completed at 2026-02-15T22:45Z. ACME reports corrected output in support ticket.

Arjun (ML): next steps for me: add the ACME prompt(s) to the billing-evals suite, write a unit that simulates seg-split at multiple boundaries, and validate on quant-attn branch. Assigning follow-up issue: https://git.internal/rwd/infra/issues/6123 (will update with test results).

Maya (CS): I'll update the ticket and ask Elena for permission to add their anonymized prompt to our evals and for permission to share any minimal logs. Also track impact for billing customers.

Elena (ACME): thanks all. appreciated the quick rollback. Please keep me in loop on when the fix is in the safe variant.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): marking thread resolved for now. Will follow up with PR to tighten seg-split tests + revert is under review for a safer implementation.

Arjun (ML): note for records: internal evals are necessary but not sufficient — we need to enrich eval coverage with real customer prompt patterns (long multiprompt sequences, invoice-like templates). Adding to roadmap. :white_check_mark:

Maya (CS): closing loop: Ticket CS-8921 -> ACME OK with rollback. Follow-ups: infra issue 6123, add prompt to billing-evals, monitoring alert on post-rollout regression spikes.
